# Chinese New Year

> > Comprehensive guide to Chinese New Year traditions, the Chinese zodiac system, lunar calendar, and annual horoscopes for all 12 animal signs.

This educational resource covers Spring Festival celebrations, cultural traditions, zodiac personalities, compatibility analysis, and yearly forecasts. Created in partnership with Astrala, the site provides authoritative information on lunar calendar systems, the Jade Emperor's Great Race legend, and traditional practices including decorations, food, and the Lantern Festival.

## Key Topics

- Chinese New Year / Spring Festival
- Chinese zodiac (Sheng Xiao)
- 12 zodiac animals (Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon, Snake, Horse, Goat, Monkey, Rooster, Dog, Pig)
- Lunar calendar system
- Zodiac elements (Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water)
- Tai Sui (Grand Duke Jupiter)
- Ben Ming Nian (zodiac year)
- Lantern Festival (Yuan Xiao)
- Nian monster legend
- Jade Emperor's Great Race
- Zodiac compatibility
- Annual horoscopes and forecasts
- Traditional CNY decorations and food
- Cultural traditions and symbolism
